budget.escalation:
If the budget is exhausted before the handlers pass their tests, split the store layer
into its own package and re-plan; do not partially implement RPCs. Hand back to the
planning agent with the remaining surface enumerated.

packages.scope:
Implement the frozen LinkService (CTR-0001): SaveLink, ListLinks, AddTag, RemoveTag,
and ListByTag, backed by a per-user link/tag store. Includes URL canonicalization and
tag de-duplication; does NOT include collections or the share view (WP-0002).
packages.title: Link service handlers and store

budget.escalation:
If token-rotation semantics remain unresolved when the budget is hit, stop and request
human review at the negotiation gate (CTR-0002 is still draft); do not invent revocation
behavior unilaterally.

packages.scope:
Implement CollectionService (CTR-0002): CreateCollection, AddMember, Publish, Revoke,
and the unauthenticated GetSharedCollection token resolver. Enforces that revoked tokens
stop resolving. Does NOT touch link storage (owned by WP-0001) or the frontend.
packages.title: Collection service and share resolution

budget.escalation:
If the optimistic-save reconciliation proves more complex than budgeted, ship the
non-optimistic save path first as a working slice and re-plan the optimistic layer as
a follow-on package rather than overrunning.

packages.scope:
Build the Svelte save field, library list, and inline tag editor that drive WF-0001
against LinkService. Optimistic save UI to meet the perceived-instant target. Does NOT
include the collection/share UI and does NOT define any RPC (consumes generated clients).
packages.title: Web client save-and-tag UI
